notes.title: Puzzle Tower Underground - Now Available!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1246810/Puzzle_Tower__Underground

[b]Puzzle Tower Underground[/b] is now available to purchase on Steam for [b]$0.99![/b]

After collecting the ancient relic from the top of the [b]Puzzle Tower[/b], you must descend into the catacombs to uncover the dark secrets of the tower's history. As you descend deeper into the catacombs, you'll face numerous puzzles, traps, and monsters that will try to stop you. You've conquered monsters, puzzles, and traps in the past, but you've never faced anything like what you're about to see.

[b]Puzzle Tower Underground[/b] brings brand new puzzles, items, bosses, and more to the original story of Puzzle Tower. The story of Underground directly follows [b]Puzzle Tower's[/b] main story. Starting from the bottom of the tower, you must descend deeper and deeper into the tower's catacombs to uncover the history of the tower. You'll be completing new puzzles, collecting new items, slaying new bosses, and more. Are you skilled enough to reach the deepest part of the catacombs and uncover the secrets?

[b]Requirements[/b]
- You must beat the base game to access the new levels.
- You must purchase the DLC on Steam for $0.99.

[b]Features[/b]
- 10 new levels
- 15+ new puzzles
- New mechanics (combat oriented puzzles)
- New items
- New soundtracks
- Brand new Steam Achievements
- Extensive single player experience with medieval atmosphere

notes.title: Puzzle Tower - Patch Notes (1/20/20)
notes.content:
[WHAT'S NEW]

- [Floor 15] Fixed a bug where there were no spikes below the ocean relic.
- [Floor 17] Rearranged the paintings to be in the order that you collect the relics in.
- [Floor 17] Added a picture of each relic above its corresponding painting to help with confusion.
- [Floor 18] Removed water buckets from inside the towers to remove unwanted confusion.

notes.content:

- [Floor 5] Bent the window bars even more to help indicate you need to place the bucket at the window.

notes.title: Puzzle Tower - Patch Notes (1/14/20)
notes.content:
Puzzle Tower Patch Notes - Bug Fixes and New Content

[WHAT'S NEW]
- [Floor 5] Changed the lever puzzle's solution to be more obvious.
- [Floor 5] Recolored all levers from red to brown.
- [Floor 9] Changed text of "three" sign to "t.h.r.e.e" help make solution more obvious.
- Reworked main menu to be easier to read in some areas.
- Added a "guides" button to the main menu to allow players to view a walkthrough of every floor.
- Added a "patch notes" button to the main menu to allow players to directly view the newest patch notes.
